verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly say cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either in the Mesh web app or through the API. A published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema covers customers, cases, audit, exports and transactions, and reference docs add endpoints for monitoring config, roles and transaction processing. However, no statement claims full UI/API parity, and API credentials are documented as created only in the web app under Settings > Access Management. Missing for 10: an explicit parity commitment, API coverage for credential and access management, evidence that risk-score equation and screening configuration management are exposed via API, and hands-on corroboration.
